dct_title_s: A chart of the Seacoaſts from the landſend of England to Cape Bonna Eſperanca
dct_description_sm: This sea chart appeared in John Seller's Atlas Maritimus or a Book of Charts ..., first published in 1675. The copperplate was later sold to John Thornton (1641-1708).
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 1006.
